title: The Company That Sells You Nothing — B-roll

narration: Planet Fitness has eighteen point seven million members.
Roughly two thousand five hundred gyms, open around the clock.
Most nights, the machines sit empty.
The lonely ones show up anyway.
If ten percent showed up, the business would not survive the month.
